translations.web: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick;
translations.bsb: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
translations.kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
